[EN] Um, , I know you have an affinity for the great and powerful Oshar."I sense a request coming."
[ES] Mmm, , sé que tienes una afinidad por la gran y poderosa Oshar."I sense a request coming."

[EN] Indeed, but it's not for Oshar—not directly, anyway. {@LinkCreature:230#1100$$Deresk} was my mentor before Oshar entered the picture.

We parted ways with...acrimony, let's say. But I'd like to make it up to him with a gift.

This potion serves two purposes: it acts as a peace offering, and it demonstrates how much I've learned from the mighty Oshar. Could you deliver it to him?
[ES] En efecto, pero no es para Oshar—al menos no directamente. {@LinkCreature:230#1100$$Deresk} fue mi mentor antes de que Oshar apareciera en escena.

Nos distanciamos con... animosidad, digamos. Pero me gustaría compensarlo con un regalo.

Esta poción cumple dos propósitos: sirve como ofrenda de paz y demuestra cuánto he aprendido de la poderosa Oshar. ¿Podrías entregársela?

[EN] has come from Filine? With all possessions intact?

We shouldn't be bitter, but Filine was our greatest failure. We are sometimes too harsh on our students. This teacher's students rebelled, concocting an imaginary mentor named "Oshar" so they could avoid their lessons and live dissolute lives as perpetual students."Filine made you this."
[ES] ¿ viene de Filine? ¿Con todas sus posesiones intactas?

No deberíamos ser amargados, pero Filine fue nuestro mayor fracaso. A veces somos demasiado duros con nuestros estudiantes. Los estudiantes de este profesor se rebelaron, inventando un mentor imaginario llamado "Oshar" para poder evitar sus lecciones y llevar una vida licenciosa como estudiantes perpetuos."Filine made you this."

[EN] There's real power in here...hmm. Perhaps we judged unfairly.
[ES] Aquí hay verdadero poder... mmm. Tal vez juzgamos injustamente.

[EN] He drank it! Ha ha ha!

After countless lectures of thinly-veiled high elf racial superiority, let's see how he likes not being a high elf—however temporarily.

Don't give me that face. He's probably back to his preening high elf form by now.

Maybe he learned a lesson, though. No matter what you might think you know, it's a bad idea to cross the great and powerful Oshar.
[ES] ¡Se la bebió! ¡Ja, ja, ja!

Tras incontables discursos de superioridad racial de los high elf apenas disimulada, veamos cómo le gusta no ser un high elf, por muy temporalmente que sea.

No me pongas esa cara. Probablemente ya haya vuelto a su forma presumida de high elf.

Aunque tal vez haya aprendido la lección. No importa lo que creas saber, es una mala idea cruzarse con la gran y poderosa Oshar.
